[P2] Search through successful map and parallel containers

If a child context calls `map`, then calls `result.throwIfError()`, its direct child is the map container, which checkpoints successfully with a `BatchResult` even when an item failed. That container has no `error`, so this filter never reaches the failed item. The enclosing context and execution remain named `ChildContextError` instead of the item's user error, even live with the complete operation tree. Traverse through batch containers to their failed descendants, preserving cycle/depth safeguards, and add composed coverage for this nesting.
